# markdown corpus

## Source

Real Markdown, copied unchanged: seven documents of ruff (github.com/astral-sh/ruff, MIT License, Copyright (c) 2022 Charles Marsh), each named `ruff_` and its path with `/` written `_`, and this repository's own documents, named `idiomatic_`, `ryo_` and `ryo_toml_`.

## Version

ruff 0.16.9, at commit `0be08a206f9c3180afd3e93bcc792ed5cb1f4db1`; the repository's own documents are those of the commit that added them; `NOTICE` names each file.
